arguments.name: Cross-Resolution Method
arguments.speaker: Framework author
arguments.conclusion: Every major claim must be read in its proper register (theology, physics, mathematics, lived reality, bridge) with no hidden upgrades.
premises: Physics may not smuggle in theology; theology may not rescue weak physics.
Story may not pretend it is proof; formal proof may not pretend to capture lived experience.
When the same structure appears across registers, we mark the bridge, name its strength, state its limits, and keep testing.
No hidden upgrades.

st1.quote: The Cross-Resolution Method requires every major claim to be read in the register where it belongs

st2.quote: Physics is not allowed to smuggle in theology. Theology is not allowed to rescue weak physics. Story is not allowed to pretend it is proof. Formal proof is not allowed to pretend it has captured the whole meaning of lived experience.

st4.quote: But when the same structure appears across registers, we do not dismiss it merely because it crosses a boundary. We mark the bridge, name its strength, state its limits, and keep testing.

st6.quote: We mark the bridge, name its strength, state its limits, and keep testing. No hidden upgrades.

st7.quote: The framework names its own kill conditions in advance

arguments.prior_art: none known (methodological regress-guard proposals in analytic theology, e.g. Nancey Murphy, Theology in the Age of Scientific Reasoning, 1990)

or1.quote: The Cross-Resolution Method requires every major claim to be read in the register where it belongs
or1.why: A variant on non-overlapping-magisteria / integrated-register methodologies rather than a wholly new methodological argument.

or3.quote: when the same structure appears across registers, we do not dismiss it merely because it crosses a boundary
or3.why: Uses a bridge register across theology, physics, mathematics and lived reality, but the cross-domain move is left abstract with no worked instance.

arguments.weakest_link: The 'bridge' register is defined by assertion: no criterion is given for when a cross-register structural resemblance is a real bridge rather than an analogy.
arguments.develop_next: State a checkable criterion (and a worked example) for when a cross-register structure counts as a bridge rather than a coincidence.

arguments.name: Necessary ground argument
arguments.speaker: Framework author
arguments.conclusion: The source sustaining the universe must be necessary, self-grounding, origin of coherence, active, and personal, which matches classical divine attributes.
premises: If closed systems collapse and the universe has not collapsed, something external sustains it.
If coherence and decoherence are real, measurable, and universal, the source of coherence must be equally real and universal.
The required properties are: necessary, self-grounding, origin of coherence, active (passive maintenance is thermodynamically impossible), and personal (only persons ground moral facts).
These properties map to aseity, self-sufficiency, eternality, omnipresence, Logos, providence, and personhood.

st1.quote: Those properties have had a name for thousands of years

st2.quote: 1. **Necessary** -- it cannot not exist, or the system collapses. 2. **Self-grounding** -- it cannot depend on something else (infinite regress). 3. **Origin of coherence** -- it must be the source of truth, order, beauty, goodness, life. 4. **Active** -- passive maintenance is thermodynamically impossible (the Second Law). 5. **Personal** -- only persons can ground moral facts (moral realism).

st3.quote: If closed systems collapse and the universe has not collapsed, then something external sustains it.

st4.quote: If coherence and decoherence are real, measurable, and universal, then the source of coherence must be equally real and universal.

st6.quote: We started from five mathematical proofs and arrived at the exact description theologians have been writing about since the beginning.

st8.quote: If closed systems collapse and the universe has not collapsed, then something external sustains it. If coherence and decoherence are real, measurable, and universal, then the source of coherence must be equally real and universal.

arguments.prior_art: Thomas Aquinas, Five Ways (Summa Theologiae I, q.2), c. 1265-1274

or1.quote: Those properties have had a name for thousands of years
or1.why: A variant of the classical necessary-ground / cosmological argument re-expressed with five 'mathematical requirements'.

or2.quote: If coherence and decoherence are real, measurable, and universal, then the source of coherence must be equally real and universal.
or2.why: Adds decoherence/coherence language as evidence, though it is asserted rather than documented.

or3.quote: passive maintenance is thermodynamically impossible (the Second Law)
or3.why: Bridges thermodynamics into theology by making the Second Law the reason the ground must be actively sustaining.

arguments.weakest_link: The premise 'only persons can ground moral facts' -- it is asserted with a parenthetical label and carries the entire move from abstract ground to a personal God.
arguments.develop_next: Defend moral-realism-plus-personal-ground with an actual argument, and supply the promised five proofs rather than citing them.

arguments.name: The Descent: 24-step causal chain
arguments.speaker: Framework author
arguments.conclusion: Being, followed all the way down through 24 steps, arrives at the Cross.
premises: God creates; creation stands; what stands is distinguishable; distinction makes being intelligible; intelligibility carries information; information can stand in relation.
Relation can be kept or broken, revealing value; value opens moral valence; moral valence makes right and wrong meaningful; right and wrong require choosing agents.
Choice requires a world of rules, limits, time, and consequences, permitting decay and adversarial refusal.
Adversarial action creates debt; perfect Justice and Mercy together require a cost-bearing source beyond the damaged order; that source is Grace; Christ is the convergence point.

st1.quote: Being, followed all the way down, arrives at the Cross.

st2.quote: God creates. Creation stands. What stands is distinguishable. Distinction makes being intelligible.

st4.quote: Adversarial action creates real debt, damage, and disorder. Perfect Justice requires that this be truthfully answered and paid. Perfect Mercy wills restoration rather than abandonment. Justice and Mercy together require a cost-bearing source beyond the damaged order itself.

st6.quote: No premise smuggled. No step skipped.

or1.quote: Justice and Mercy together require a cost-bearing source beyond the damaged order itself. That source must preserve truth while making restoration possible. That source is Grace.
or1.why: A variant of the Anselmian satisfaction/atonement logic, re-cast as a 24-step chain from ontology to the Cross.

or4.quote: The whole causal chain in 24 steps
or4.why: Adds a numbered stepwise structure, but the steps are prose links rather than formalized inference rules.

arguments.weakest_link: The step from 'adversarial action creates real debt' to 'perfect Justice requires that this be truthfully answered and paid' -- a contested retributive-justice premise carrying the whole chain.
arguments.develop_next: Justify the retributive-justice premise (and the necessity of a cost-bearing source) rather than asserting it as a step.

arguments.name: Progressive revelation as pedagogy
arguments.speaker: Framework author
arguments.conclusion: God reveals progressively because receivers cannot parse the full signal at once; He builds the reference frame piece by piece.
premises: God meets people in slavery, wilderness, under Law, through prophets, and in exile, each experience building vocabulary for rescue, provision, failure, pattern, and return.
Without the experience of failing to keep the Law, one cannot understand the Judge paying the debt Himself.
This is not God being slow but God being a teacher.
You do not teach calculus to a child who has not learned to count, not because calculus is untrue but because the child lacks the reference frame.

st1.quote: God does not dump the full signal on Day One because the receivers cannot parse it.

st2.quote: He meets them in slavery -- and turns their deliverance into the vocabulary through which rescue can be understood. He meets them in wilderness -- and teaches provision through manna, water from rock, the pillar of fire.

st3.quote: He meets them under Law -- the Ten Commandments, the sacrificial system, the impossible-to-perfectly-keep legal code

st4.quote: This is not God being slow. This is God being a teacher. You do not teach calculus to a child who has not learned to count.

st6.quote: God does not dump the full signal on Day One because the receivers cannot parse it.

arguments.prior_art: Irenaeus, Against Heresies (recapitulation/paideia), c. 180; John Henry Newman, Essay on the Development of Christian Doctrine, 1845

or1.quote: God does not dump the full signal on Day One because the receivers cannot parse it.
or1.why: A variant of patristic divine-pedagogy / doctrinal-development accounts, restated in information-signal vocabulary.

or2.quote: He meets them in slavery -- and turns their deliverance into the vocabulary through which rescue can be understood.
or2.why: Uses the specific exodus-wilderness-law-exile sequence as ordered vocabulary-building, a more granular reading than the classical version.

or3.quote: because the child does not have the reference frame to receive it
or3.why: Imports cognitive/developmental 'reference frame' framing into theology, though only as an analogy.

arguments.weakest_link: The premise that the Law's unkeepability was necessary for understanding the Judge paying the debt -- asserted, not argued, and it presupposes the atonement logic it is meant to explain.
arguments.develop_next: Show from the biblical text that the failure-experience is presented as the intended pedagogical mechanism, not a retrospective reading.

arguments.name: Evidence converges from every direction
arguments.speaker: Framework author
arguments.conclusion: Every path of inquiry converges on the same substrate because reality has one substrate that has been telling us its name since the beginning.
premises: Pre-human math: the sun used E=mc^2 for 4.6 billion years before Einstein.
Fine-tuning: the cosmological constant is tuned to 1 part in 10^120, which is signature not coincidence.
The Hubble Tension is a 5-sigma discrepancy that one framework resolves.
You can enter through logic, physics, information theory, biology, mathematics, cosmology, or moral measurement, and every path converges.

st2.quote: The sun used E=mc^2 for 4.6 billion years before Einstein. ... The cosmological constant is tuned to 1 part in 10^120. ... The universe expands at two different rates depending on how you measure it. 5-sigma discrepancy.

st3.quote: The cosmological constant is tuned to 1 part in 10^120. That is not coincidence. That is signature.

st4.quote: You can enter through logic, physics, information theory, biology, mathematics, cosmology, or the measurement of good and evil itself. Every path converges.

st6.quote: Every path converges. Not because we forced it -- but because reality has one substrate, and that substrate has been telling us its name since the beginning.

st8.quote: You can enter through logic, physics, information theory, biology, mathematics, cosmology, or the measurement of good and evil itself.

arguments.prior_art: Robin Collins, 'The Teleological Argument: An Exploration of the Fine-Tuning of the Universe', 2009

or1.quote: The cosmological constant is tuned to 1 part in 10^120. That is not coincidence. That is signature.
or1.why: A variant of standard fine-tuning arguments, bundled with additional convergence claims.

or2.quote: The sun used E=mc^2 for 4.6 billion years before Einstein. Where was the equation?
or2.why: Adds the pre-human-math and Hubble-Tension items to the usual fine-tuning evidence set.

or3.quote: the measurement of good and evil itself
or3.why: Claims a convergence between moral measurement and physics, but the connection is named only in a list, not developed.

arguments.weakest_link: The convergence claim itself: the listed items (pre-human math, fine-tuning, Hubble Tension) are not shown to converge on one substrate -- 'every path converges' is asserted.
arguments.develop_next: Demonstrate convergence for at least two paths explicitly (e.g. how the Hubble Tension is resolved by the framework), instead of listing them.

arguments.name: Canon reading order
arguments.speaker: Framework author
arguments.conclusion: The God pages must be read in a deliberate sequence: story first, equations second, gauntlet last.
premises: The sequence starts with God and story, moves through Trinity and Truth, then lets axioms carry the weight.
The 7Q Classifier comes after the foundation because it is not the doorway but the gauntlet.

The ten-step order runs from The Descent through God in the Equations, You Are God, Trinity Signature, Story With Receipts, Holding God Accountable, The Foundation, 7Q Classifier, Master Equation, and Ten Laws.

st1.quote: The reading rule is: story first, equations second, gauntlet last.

st2.quote: The God pages follow a deliberate sequence: start with God and story, move through Trinity and Truth, then let the axioms carry the weight.

st4.quote: The 7Q Classifier comes after the foundation because it is not the doorway; it is the gauntlet.

st6.quote: The God pages follow a deliberate sequence: start with God and story, move through Trinity and Truth, then let the axioms carry the weight.

or1.quote: The reading rule is: story first, equations second, gauntlet last.
or1.why: A house-specific editorial/pedagogical ordering rule rather than a restatement of any external argument.

or2.quote: The 7Q Classifier comes after the foundation because it is not the doorway; it is the gauntlet.
or2.why: Introduces the framework's own artifact sequence as support.

arguments.weakest_link: The premise that the sequence must be this order -- no reason is given why an alternative order would fail.
arguments.develop_next: Give one concrete failure mode that occurs if the reader takes the gauntlet (7Q) before the foundation.
